sn35.7:1.3: Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmim pi cakkhusmim anapekho hoti ||

sn35.7:1.10: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako atītāya jivhāya anapekho hoti ||
